sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct verb form based on suffix and stem-change pairs

items.prompt: Он наконец _____ эту задачу. (He finally solved this problem.)
items.explanation: Наконец = completed result. Perfective: решил (решать → решить, suffix -ать → -ить).

items.prompt: Она каждый день _____ письма. (She receives letters every day.)
items.explanation: Каждый день = habitual. Imperfective present: получает (from получать).

items.prompt: Он _____ что-то интересное. (He said something interesting.)
items.promptEnglish: He said something interesting. (single completed speech act)
items.hint: Single completed speech act = perfective. Говорить → сказать.
items.explanation: Single completed utterance = perfective: сказал (suppletive pair: говорить → сказать).

items.prompt: Мы долго _____ ей вопросы. (We asked her questions for a long time.)
items.promptEnglish: We asked her questions for a long time.

minimalPairs.context: Ребёнок _____ игрушку со стола. (The child took a toy from the table.) - single action
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The child took a toy. (single completed action)
minimalPairs.explanation: Single completed action = perfective: взял (suppletive pair: брать → взять).

minimalPairs.context: Ребёнок часто _____ игрушки со стола. (The child often took toys from the table.) - repeated
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The child often took toys. (repeated habit)

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ ему правду. (She told him the truth.) - single speech act
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She told him the truth. (one-time statement)
minimalPairs.explanation: Single completed speech act: сказала (perfective of говорить).

minimalPairs.context: Она долго _____ по телефону. (She talked on the phone for a long time.) - process
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She talked on the phone for a long time.

blanks: Положи книгу на стол. Кто _____ её сюда? (Who put it here?)
Ученик правильно _____ на вопрос. (The student answered the question correctly.)
Я уже _____ посылку. (I already received the package.)
hints: Класть → положить (suppletive pair). Single completed action.
explanations: Отвечать → ответить (-ать → -ить, ч → т). Past: ответил.

sets.title: Sort and Pair
sets.description: Sort verbs and identify which formation pattern they follow
sets.descriptionRussian: Рассортируйте глаголы по типу образования пар

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: how is the perfective formed?

patternRecognition.sentence: решать → решить, получать → получить, отвечать → ответить
patternRecognition.question: What pattern do all these aspect pairs follow?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are suffix pairs: the imperfective ending -ать changes to perfective -ить.

patternRecognition.sentence: брать → взять, говорить → сказать, класть → положить
patternRecognition.question: What pattern do all these pairs follow?
patternRecognition.explanation: These are suppletive (stem-change) pairs: the words are completely different and must be memorized.

errorCorrection.sentence: Каждый день она сказала ему 'доброе утро'.
errorCorrection.explanation: Каждый день = habitual. Imperfective: говорила (not perfective сказала).
Долго = process. Imperfective of взять is брать: он долго брал.

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Build sentences and translate using suffix and stem-change pairs

translation.english: Put the bag on the floor.
translation.hint: put (command) = положи, bag = сумку, floor = пол

translation.english: He took the keys and left.
translation.hint: took = взял (perfective of брать), keys = ключи

items.prompt: What is the imperfective of сказать (to say)?
items.promptEnglish: What is the imperfective pair of сказать?
items.hint: This is a suppletive pair with completely different stems.
items.explanation: Говорить / сказать is a suppletive pair: the stems are completely different.

items.prompt: What is the perfective of класть (to put)?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of класть?
items.explanation: Класть / положить is a suppletive pair. Покласть and кладить don't exist.

items.prompt: What is the perfective of брать (to take)?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of брать?
items.hint: Suppletive pair. Забрать and выбрать have different meanings.
items.explanation: Брать / взять is a suppletive pair. Забрать (take away) and выбрать (choose) are different verbs.

sets.title: Tricky Changes
sets.description: Notice consonant changes in suffix pairs and choose correctly

patternRecognition.sentence: отвечать → ответить (ч → т), встречать → встретить (ч → т)
patternRecognition.question: What consonant change happens in these suffix pairs?
patternRecognition.explanation: In these suffix pairs, ч in the imperfective changes to т in the perfective.

patternRecognition.question: What consonant change happens here?
patternRecognition.explanation: Щ in the imperfective changes to т in the perfective. The same pattern as ч → т.

items.prompt: Мы _____ старых друзей на вечеринке. (We met old friends at the party.)
items.promptEnglish: We met old friends at the party. (single event)
items.hint: Single completed meeting = perfective. Встречать → встретить.
items.explanation: Single event = perfective: встретили (встречать → встретить, ч → т).

items.prompt: Мальчик всегда _____ на вопросы учителя. (The boy always answers the teacher's questions.)
items.promptEnglish: The boy always answers the teacher's questions.

items.prompt: Она _____ посылку сегодня утром. (She received a package this morning.)
items.promptEnglish: She received a package this morning.
items.hint: Received (single completed event this morning) = perfective.

blanks: Он уже _____ все задачи. (He already solved all the problems.)
Мы часто _____ друзей в кафе. (We often meet friends at the cafe.)
Она вчера _____ мне правду. (She told me the truth yesterday.)
Не _____ мои вещи! (Don't take my things!)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Mixed suffix and stem-change pairs in context
hints: Single speech act yesterday = perfective of говорить.
Negative command for repeated action = imperfective imperative of брать.
explanations: Single completed speech act: сказала (говорить → сказать).
Negative commands for 'don't do this' generally use imperfective: не бери (not не возьми).

minimalPairs.explanation: Negative commands ('don't do X') typically use imperfective imperative: не бери.

minimalPairs.context: _____ зонт, будет дождь. (Take an umbrella, it'll rain.) - positive advice
minimalPairs.explanation: Positive single commands typically use perfective imperative: возьми.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A final round combining prefix, suffix, and stem-change pairs
sets.descriptionRussian: Финальный раунд: приставки, суффиксы и чередования основ

items.prompt: _____ книгу на полку, пожалуйста. (Put the book on the shelf, please.)
items.promptEnglish: Put the book on the shelf, please. (single command)
items.explanation: Positive command: perfective imperative положи (from класть → положить).

items.prompt: Что ты _____? (What did you say?) - asking about a single utterance
items.promptEnglish: What did you say? (single speech act)
items.hint: Asking about one specific thing said = perfective.
items.explanation: Asking about a single utterance = perfective: сказала (говорить → сказать).

items.prompt: Мы вчера _____ друзей в парке. (We met friends in the park yesterday.)
items.promptEnglish: We met friends in the park yesterday. (single event)

items.prompt: Раньше мы часто _____ по телефону. (We used to talk on the phone often.)
items.promptEnglish: We used to talk on the phone often.
items.hint: Часто (often) + раньше (before) = habitual in the past.

errorCorrection.explanation: Каждый вечер = habitual. Imperfective: говорил, not сказал.
